thread.subject: Deepfake and vishing awareness - question from a mid-sized broker
thread.we: Hi Julius, I watched the live recording of your ONE Conference session, and the point that realistic replicas of the scams people actually face do far more than e-learning is exactly the argument my board needs to hear right now. Two weeks ago our finance team took a call in our CFO's voice asking to change bank details for a broker commission. It was caught at the last moment only because someone rang back. The board now wants a deepfake and vishing awareness programme before the next renewal c
thread.they: Hi Katharina, thanks for writing, and glad the ONE Conference session was useful. Sorry to hear about the CFO voice call. Good that someone rang back. That is exactly the habit we try to build. Short answer: yes, 700 people with a works council is well within what we do. Starting with finance and claims is also how I would do it. Voice and deepfake simulations on a small group first, then widen. The works council is your best friend here, so involve them early. Yes, please send the requirements
their_questions: A few things would help me route it to the right colleague: - Roughly how many people are in finance and claims?
- What timeline does the board have in mind: pilot start, and decision before which renewal date?
- Who else is involved in the decision on your side?
their_asks: Yes, please send the requirements profile.
